[NDBG.12.1.4] Logpoints (`logMessage`) are supported. The message is
a DS interpolation string (`"fired with value={s.value}"`); the adapter
emits an `output` event of category `"important"` rather than pausing. A
logpoint must log each time the session crosses its hit moving forward, and
never moving back or while re-driving from a checkpoint ([NDBG.14r.2.3]).
Each line opens with the firing and the instant. With no source for the
program, a logpoint is `verified: false` with message `"needs the program's
source"`.
